title: Make remote test runs visible locally and support resume from another remote
outcome: Operators can see remote test runs locally and resume coordination from another remote session without losing the run's identity or result.
acceptance: A remote test run is visible from the local host with its identity, status, execution host and result when available.
A session on another remote host can resume coordination for an existing remote run and obtain its eventual result without starting a duplicate run.
The design states how unavailable hosts, permissions, stale status and delivery failures are reported, and tests cover the supported cross-host flow.
